project.project_title: Senior Full-Stack / Platform Engineer for AI SaaS Platform

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: I’d like you to assess the front end and give me your release 1 recommendation.

value_updates.deliverable: Front-end review with a Release 1 recommendation

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Hi [FREELANCER_NAME_001], that sounds reasonable. I’ll supply the list of R1 routes and screens that are built sufficiently for review.
After the Upwork contract and the confidentiality/IP arrangements have been established, we’ll grant named, read-only repo access and provide a staging URL. No production credentials or customer data will be included.
Before granting access, please confirm that your proposed review deliverable will cover:
a Release 1 readiness recommendation
prioritised findings and blockers, supported by evidence
security, architecture, performance and maintainability risks
recommended remediation and indicative effort
explicit assumptions and anything excluded from the review
Please also share an indicative price range or capped discovery allowance now. Once you’ve examined the materials, you can confirm the final scope, fixed price and delivery date.

value_updates.review_scope: R1 routes and screens identified as sufficiently built for review
required_outputs: Prioritised findings and blockers with supporting evidence
Security, architecture, performance and maintainability risks
Clear assumptions and items excluded from the review

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Okay, great—I’m comfortable with that. If you send me a proposal through upowork, we can proceed from there.

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text:
I’ve completed the front-end Release 1 audit. All materials are available in the shared Drive folder [URL_001]:

• BIQc Audit — Word — the seven-document report
• BIQc Audit — Markdown source — identical content prepared for Anjali
• working journal — the verification task list included for reference

Please begin with 01\_FOUNDER\_SUMMARY. It requires no technical background and explains the recommendation, readiness by module, and cost. The remaining documents provide supporting reference material: 02 contains the complete findings register with file/line evidence and hours, 03 gives the remediation sequence, 04 is the evidence log, 05 addresses the scope and timeline question, and 06 lists assumptions and exclusions.

The headline is that I cannot recommend approving Release 1 for external launch in its present condition. In addition, the scope you confirmed on Sunday—multi-user, instant revocation, and Wallet—cannot fit into this week. Section 6 of the founder summary describes two workable options.

execution.observed_behavior: Freelancer reports completing and delivering the front-end Release 1 audit, including the readiness recommendation, findings with file-and-line evidence, remediation sequence, evidence log, and assumptions and exclusions.

source_message.speaker: client

source_message.speaker: freelancer
source_message.text: I’m uploading the materials here too, ensuring that the deliverables and their supporting evidence are included in the contract record. These are the same files shared on Slack: the corrected report pack and the evidence bundle.
